title: UMass Women’s Basketball vs. Ball State: Education Day at Mullins Center
description: A weekday matchup at the University of Massachusetts’ 9,493-seat campus arena carries an Education Day billing.

title: Printmaking for the Holidays: Lino-Block Stamp Workshop at Troutdale Library
description: Design, carve and print a lino-block stamp in a single workshop that includes guidance on safe carving and printing technique. The library suggests using the prints for cards, wrapping paper and decorations.

title: Open Studio: Paint With Your Community at Woodward Contemporary
description: Bring your own art supplies for self-directed studio time, or choose a recurring three-day schedule. Wednesday afternoons add a critique with Carlos Castrejon; Tuesday hours merit a check before you go.

title: Learn about Google Sheets with Goodwill Industries at East County Library
description: Goodwill Industries of the Columbia Willamette volunteers lead a beginner-oriented introduction to Google Sheets, from getting familiar with its tools to using formulas and charts.

title: Magic: The Gathering Game Night at Mighty Squirrel Brewing Co. — Feb. 17, 2027
description: The Fenway listing gives a date and 6 p.m. start, but not the play format, entry terms or which part of the taproom will host the game.

title: Lego Club: LEGO Building Session at Holgate Library
description: Holgate Library provides the building blocks for this one-hour session, intended for grades K–5; younger and older siblings are welcome.

title: Lego Club: LEGO Building Session at Rockwood Library
description: Rockwood Library supplies the LEGO blocks for this participant-led session. Children in grades K–5 are the focus, and younger and older siblings are welcome.

title: Magic: The Gathering Game Night at Mighty Squirrel Brewing Co.
description: The Fenway listing puts the game night at 6 p.m. on Wednesday, Feb. 10, 2027; it does not give admission terms or explain how play will work.

title: The Underachievers and Lord Sko at Gramercy Theatre — Dec. 6, 2026
description: The Underachievers headline a hip-hop bill with Lord Sko at Gramercy Theatre on Sunday, Dec. 6. Doors are listed for 7 p.m.; no performance start time is published.

title: Baby Jam: Monday Music at National Children’s Museum
description: A half-hour session in Little Dreamers invites children ages 0–3 to join in with instruments and explore movement, rhythm and sound.

title: Across to Bainbridge on foot
description: Take the Bainbridge Island ferry from Seattle on foot. Check round-trip fares, walk-on boarding, holiday sailings, the free art museum and two Winslow waterfront walks.

title: Calle Ocho over coffee
description: Walk Miami’s Little Havana from Cuban Memorial Boulevard to Domino Park, Tower Theater and a Cuban coffee stop. Find park hours, trolley service and what to order.

title: The trees Chicago makes together
description: Plan Christmas Around the World at Chicago’s Museum of Science and Industry. Find six trees on the 2026 map, compare tickets and check holiday hours.

title: The two faces of Mammoth Cave
description: Compare three Mammoth Cave National Park tours by stairs, distance and ticket price. Find the winter schedule for Mammoth Passage, Frozen Niagara and Domes & Dripstones.

title: Two pools and a long evening at Hearst Castle
description: Compare Hearst Castle tour tickets in San Simeon, California. See the Neptune and Roman pools, Holiday Twilight dates, stairs, shuttle and accessible routes.

title: Where winter starts above Palm Springs
description: Plan the Palm Springs Aerial Tramway in winter. Check online fares, walk-up tickets, parking, holiday hours and closures, Long Valley snow and short hikes.

title: The trains that stayed in Brooklyn
description: Visit the New York Transit Museum in Brooklyn, compare tickets and accessibility, and find the Sunday 2026 Holiday Nostalgia Train and free Grand Central show.

title: Stay for the last light at White Sands
description: Plan a winter visit to White Sands National Park near Alamogordo, New Mexico. Compare Dunes Drive hikes, sledding slopes, $25 admission, sunset hours and the boardwalk closure.

title: Honolulu’s finish line waits
description: Plan the Honolulu Marathon on Dec. 13. The race starts at 5 a.m. and the start line closes at 5:30 a.m. Check the course, fees, 10K finish and zoo shuttle.

title: Two Saturdays at Cowboy Christmas
description: Plan Cowboy Christmas in Las Vegas, Dec. 3–12, 2026. Compare the two Saturday rodeo schedules, find the free gift show and check the $10 Junior NFR admission.
